summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Funland CRM. 20/20 pytest backend tests PASSED covering auth, dashboard stats, games/packages (admin-only), inquiries (webhook+CRUD+status update by both roles), bill computation & totals (subtotal 350, GST 59.4, total 389.4), customer auto-upsert with history, mark-paid + dashboard revenue update, bill send via whatsapp/sms/email returning simulated=true, attendance flow (checkin/double-block/checkout/me/all admin-only), settings admin-only (employee 403), campaigns whatsapp+instagram (employee 403), integrations status (all false since keys empty), staff list admin-only. Frontend: admin login works with seeded creds, KPI cards visible, dashboard renders revenue chart + top games, inquiry/game create dialogs functional, settings save works, admin can access marketing/staff/settings. Employee login: correctly redirected away from /staff /marketing /settings back to dashboard, sidebar hides admin-only nav items, attendance page accessible.

issues: Recharts console warning on initial mount: width(-1) height(-1) — cosmetic, chart still renders correctly after layout settles
A11y warning: DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby — should add DialogDescription for accessibility

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to shadcn Dialog components to silence a11y warnings
(Optional) Fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer initial width/height warning by setting minWidth/minHeight on container
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 761 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers/modules (auth, bills, inquiries, marketing, settings) for maintainability
PATCH /api/inquiries/{id}/status uses model dumping conditionally with 'if data.notes is not None' — OK, but note that empty string is treated as valid; acceptable

dashboard/stats uses string comparison `created_at >= today` where today is date-only 'YYYY-MM-DD' but stored created_at is full ISO — works since ISO is lexicographically sortable, but fragile if timezone changes
_send_message: Twilio 'sms' branch sends body without any From prefix; correct. WhatsApp channel silently 'simulated' when TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM missing — matches spec
No rate limiting / brute force protection on /api/auth/login (spec mentions lockout in playbook_testing_instructions; not implemented but not required for MVP)
seed_admin does not update password if admin already exists — if ADMIN_PASSWORD env changes it won't take effect. Not a bug for this run since seed already applied and default matches.
test_credentials: admin@funland.in / Funland@123 (seeded). Employee accounts created dynamically via POST /api/users during tests.
seed_data_creation: Test data created via tests uses TEST_ prefix for names/emails. Games/packages created during test are deleted on tear-down. Some inquiries (TEST_Whatsapp_Lead, TEST_Cust) remain in DB and are visible in UI screenshots.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 20 tests, runs in ~7s. Admin seed exists. All external integration keys (Razorpay/Twilio/Resend) are empty, so /api/bills/{id}/send returns simulated=true and /api/integrations/status returns all false — this is the intended MVP behavior. Frontend testids covered in review_request work as specified.
